title: After sealing the Vale barrow's doors for good, returning to Barrow Field still shows the 'go in' option's locked-reason text listing all three hypothetical unlock methods ('the blessing, force, or the loose stone') even though the doors are now permanently sealed and none of those apply any more.
where: Barrow Field, the Vale of Ash
